lines.prompt: Please count all the gates in this design and report the total count broken down by gate type (AND, OR, NOT, NAND, NOR, XOR, XNOR, BUF, DFF).

golden.reference: Total 112,114 gates: AND 0, OR 916, NOT 6844, NAND 77998, NOR 8005, XOR 86, XNOR 1358, BUF 857, DFF 16050.
golden.notes: All 4 full-score teams report the identical breakdown; this is objective ground truth on the original netlist. Team7 additionally notes combinational-only total 96,064 (extra detail, acceptable). Checker: all nine per-type counts must match; total 112114 = sum.

team_answers.Team2: AND 0, OR 916, NOT 6844, NAND 77998, NOR 8005, XOR 86, XNOR 1358, BUF 857, DFF 16050; total 112114.

lines.prompt: Find all pairs of back-to-back inverters (NOT followed by NOT) in this design and collapse them into direct wire connections. Ensure the design functionality does not change.

golden.reference: Collapsed all back-to-back inverter pairs into direct wire connections; functional equivalence preserved.
golden.notes: Transform must claim success and functionality preserved; verification happens on the output netlist. Reported pair/rewrite counts diverge sharply among FULL-SCORE teams (Team3/Team4: 306; Team2: 2405 rewrites; Team7: 2410 pairs / 4820 NOTs removed), so the raw count is NOT graded and depends on counting method (unique disjoint pairs vs. iterative fanout-aware rewrites). Checker sanity: success + equivalence claim; output netlist must be equivalent and ideally contain no remaining NOT-NOT chains.

team_answers.Team2: Applied not(not(x))->x 2405 times, eliminated 2405 gates; equivalence preserved.
team_answers.Team3: Collapsed back-to-back inverters; 306 instances changed; functionality preserved.
team_answers.Team4: Applied 306 verified pattern rewrites; equivalence preserved.
team_answers.Team7: Collapsed 2410 pairs (4820 NOTs removed); 0 pairs remain; nothing changed functionally.

lines.prompt: What is the maximum combinational logic depth in the design now?

golden.reference: The maximum combinational logic depth is 77.
golden.notes: Asked after the inverter-pair collapse, so nominally post-transform, but all 4 full-score teams report 77 despite removing different numbers of inverters — the critical path is unaffected by the collapse. Treat 77 as the expected value; Team7 additionally names deepest endpoint n22[11] (extra detail, not required).

team_answers.Team2: Maximum logic depth is 77 gate levels.

golden.notes: All 4 full-score teams answer equivalent/yes. Response must affirm equivalence; a bare 'Yes.' (Team2) was accepted.
